scope: Same candidate input/seed/window/clock replay, not new Monte Carlo samples or native random-path matching

comparison_scope.scope: exploratory 40-candidate-replica prediction against one saved native realization per case
comparison_scope.primary: 0–5ms restricted mean active lifetime of the fixed 287-ID cohort
comparison_scope.dependence: within-replica IDs/time need not be iid for these replica ranks; A/P with the same seed/native keys may be coupled and are analyzed separately, never pooled as80 independent replicas
comparison_scope.multiple_metrics: primary and exploratory secondary functional/scalar ranks reported separately; probabilities are not a simultaneous all-metric PASS
comparison_scope.prediction_vs_mean: 40-candidate min/max is a 39/41≈95.12% prediction interval under continuous exchangeable null, not a confidence interval for the ensemble mean; ties make coverage conservative

note: Current candidate replay plus unchanged saved native reference. Same seeds are not new independent Monte Carlo samples. Previously reviewed practical interpretation is retained; no report-owned V&V gate is computed.
